title: Correct an invalid commander identity
description: A commander enters a name, receives a focused validation remedy for an overlong draft, corrects it and receives the real encrypted-save acknowledgement before recovering it after reload.

steps.description: Sign in and open the production identity editor.
steps.acknowledgement: The authenticated identity editor is ready.
verifications: Save is available and no profile command has been submitted.

steps.description: Draft a valid name and select the Deepseer portrait.
steps.acknowledgement: The name and portrait remain selected locally.
verifications: Editing has not written a profile.

steps.description: Attempt to save a 25-character name and read the specific validation remedy.
steps.acknowledgement: The editor explains the 2–24 character requirement.
verifications: The invalid draft and portrait are retained, focus returns to the name, and reconnect is not offered.

steps.description: Correct the name in the preserved draft.
steps.acknowledgement: The corrected draft is ready to save.
verifications: The portrait remains selected and no command was sent before commitment.

steps.description: Save the corrected identity and wait for authoritative acceptance.
steps.acknowledgement: Identity saved confirms the accepted command.
verifications: The validation error clears and exactly one canonical revision, version and receipt exist.

steps.description: Reload and recover the accepted correction without another write.
steps.acknowledgement: The saved name and portrait are recovered.
verifications: Recovery keeps the original saved revision and no validation error.
